name: Hotel Neue Post
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Hotel Neue Post in Mayrhofen**

Nestled in the heart of the **Zillertal Alps**, **Mayrhofen** is the perfect starting point for unforgettable adventures in **Tirol**. Our **Hotel Neue Post** invites you to experience authentic Tyrolean hospitality in a cozy, family-run atmosphere.

### **Relax & Enjoy**
After an exciting day on the slopes or hiking in the **Hohe Tauern**, unwind in our comfortable rooms and suites. Savor traditional Tyrolean dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Schlutzkrapfen**, or hearty **Käsespätzle** in our rustic **Stüberl** restaurant. For a refreshing break, our **Wellness Oasis** offers a sauna, steam bath, and relaxation area with mountain views.

### **Adventure Awaits**
Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, **Mayrhofen** is a paradise for winter sports enthusiasts. Whether you're skiing, snowboarding, or cross-country skiing, our ski school partners will ensure you make the most of the **Zillertal Arena**. In summer, explore the **Gerlos Valley** or take a scenic gondola ride to the **Ahornspitze**.

### **Family-Friendly & Central**
Our hotel is centrally located, just steps away from **Mayrhofen’s** charming village center, shops, and restaurants. Families will love our kids' play area and easy access to sledding hills and summer hiking trails.

### **Your Home in the Alps**
At **Hotel Neue Post**, we combine warm hospitality with modern comforts. Whether you're planning a romantic getaway, a family vacation, or a sports adventure, we’re here to make your stay in **Tirol** truly special.

**We look forward to welcoming you!**
